_comment: Which language a folder is written in, as the tag a speech synthesiser
takes. There is nothing to fill in, for the same reason alphabets.json has
nothing to fill in: a language folder already carries a flag and a name.
byName is keyed exactly as alphabets.json's byName is, and deliberately so.
That file already answers 'which country speaks what' in its byCountry map,
so this one does not restate it — the lookup goes flag -> alphabets.byCountry
-> name -> the tag below, and a country added there is spoken here for free.
byCountry is the exception list, and only that: the places where the region
genuinely changes the voice rather than the language. Portuguese in Brazil
and Portuguese in Portugal are different enough that the wrong one is worth
noticing, and 'pt' alone gets whichever the machine happens to have. A
country whose accent a learner would not be misled by is not listed.
